subject: Error:  invalid argument to unary operator

messages.author: ebb1ab0c02004eee
messages.subject: Error:  invalid argument to unary operator
parts:
Hi All, 

Thank you for this awesome tool! I am running into trouble using the function for modeling the probabilistic selection task. For background, I am running on RStudio version 1.1.456 with an R version of 3.5.1 and RStan version 2.18.1. 

My code
output <-- pst_gainloss_Q(data = '/Users/jennygilbert/Documents/RW_bevel/example.txt', niter = 2000,nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 1, ncore = 1, nthin = 1, inits = "random", indPars = "mean", saveDir = NULL, modelRegressor = FALSE, vb = FALSE, inc_postpred = FALSE, adapt_delta = 0.95, stepsize = 1, max_treedepth = 10)

Error message
Error in -pst_gainloss_Q(data = "/Users/jennygilbert/Documents/RW_bevel/all_clean.txt",  : 
  invalid argument to unary operator

Has anyone encountered this error? I'm not sure if this is in reference to how my data is formatted, something in the pst_gainloss_Q call, or something else entirely. So far, stack overflow hasn't helped, so I'd love help troubleshooting!

Thanks in advance! 
Jenny

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: Error:  invalid argument to unary operator
parts:
Hi Jenny,

Sorry for a delayed reply. I could run the model with your data without a problem using the following code. I downloaded the example.txt to the '~/Downloads' folder and ran the following code:

output = pst_gainloss_Q("~/Downloads/example.txt", 2000, 1000, 2, 2)

Note that you don't have to specify some input arguments if you use default values. Check out our tutorial website for more details: https://rpubs.com/CCSL/hBayesDM. 

Could you try again and get back to us if you encounter a problem again? 

Best,
Young
